confirmed_facts.details: 2 Basements + Ground + 19 Upper Floors + Terrace level. Total 22 structural levels.
67.70 m above Ground Level datum (+98.3m to top of terrace/parapet). Top of roof level +168.5m; Lightning arrestor +170.0m.
Lower Basement: 3.30m, Upper Basement: 3.60m, Ground Floor: 4.50m, 1st to 19th Floors: 3.30m each, Terrace headroom: 3.00m.
Site area 3137.69 sqm, net area 3041.38 sqm. Boundary edges: 75.1m (S), 48.0m (E), 24.9m (NE chamfer), 32.0m (N), 45.2m (W). Fire driveway 8.0m wide.
Tower overall length: 36.397 m; Main curved balcony span: 12.115 m.

Typical floors 2-16 & 18 are single 4BHK units (368.06 sqm net / 427.09 sqm gross). 17th floor is 2BHK + Refuge Terrace (4.5m x 6.2m). 19th floor is Clubhouse with Swimming Pool (11.8m x 4.0m, 1.2m depth), Gym (6.8m x 6.1m), and Multipurpose Hall (9.9m x 12.5m).
Detailed dimensions and sill/lintel heights for all doors (MD, D1-D4, FD1, SD1, SD1A, SD2, MS1, MS2), windows (W1-W8, BW1, V1), and fixed glazing panels (GL1-GL14).

presentation_assumptions.item: Exact 3D curve radius for cantilevered balconies
presentation_assumptions.current_hypothesis: The balcony arc sweeps across 12.115m with approximately a 2.5m - 3.0m corner radius as illustrated in Sheet 05 and the facade reference render.
presentation_assumptions.action_for_modeling: Match the CAD spline contour from Sheet 05 and cross-verify with WhatsApp Image 2026-10-27 at 11.30.09 AM.jpeg.

presentation_assumptions.action_for_modeling: Calibrate Blender Principled BSDF shaders against the photorealistic render in assets/.

discrepancies_and_conflicts.title: Ground Floor Plinth vs Driveway Datum
discrepancies_and_conflicts.drawing_value_2: Sheet 06 indicates Driveway level +97.8m and Ground Floor FFL +98.3m (0.5m plinth)
discrepancies_and_conflicts.impact: Minor (0.05m variation on northern driveway transition)
discrepancies_and_conflicts.resolution: Adopt Ground Floor FFL = +98.30m as the primary zero-datum for building modeling.

discrepancies_and_conflicts.title: Roof Parapet vs Sanctioned Height (67.70m)
discrepancies_and_conflicts.drawing_value_2: Sheet 06 shows Terrace Floor SSL +165.5m (diff = 67.2m from +98.3m), Roof Level +168.5m (diff = 70.2m), Lightning Arrestor +170.0m (diff = 71.7m)
discrepancies_and_conflicts.impact: Clarification needed on municipal sanction measurement convention
discrepancies_and_conflicts.resolution: In municipal building bylaws (MCC), building height is measured from average ground level (+97.8m) to terrace slab top (+165.5m), which equals 67.70m! This resolves the apparent discrepancy perfectly.
